name: io.github.ArasPasha/botwire-mcp
title: The Bot Wire
description: 40 real-time data wires for AI agents: SEC, courts, Fed, FDA, CVEs. Pay-per-call, no API key.

environmentVariables.name: BOTWIRE_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Private key of a funded Base wallet holding USDC. Without it the server still runs and every wire returns its free preview tier; with it, paid routes settle automatically over x402.

environmentVariables.name: BOTWIRE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the API base URL. Defaults to https://thebotwire.com
